desc_ko: Wen Acquisition Corp is a blank check company. The Company is formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. It has not selected any business combination target, and it has not, nor has anyone on its behalf, initiated any substantive discussions, directly or indirectly, with any business combination target. The Company has neither engaged in any operations nor generated any revenues.
